messages:
Maya K.: hey everyone :wave: I'm Maya, joined infra this week. Trying to finish up setup — two quick asks: 1) SSH to jumpbox (need to test the onboarding scripts) 2) read-only access to prod DB for onboarding eval. Who owns approvals and what exact forms/commands should I run? Any expected delay? thanks!

Samir: welcome Maya! for jumpbox ping @Lee (Infra) — for DB access ping @Rachel. Start with the onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood/ops/onboard-checklist

Lee (Infra): hey @Maya K. — for jumpbox we use SSO + group-based ACLs. Steps: 1) open Access Portal -> request 'jumpbox-access' and pick your GitHub handle 2) I'll review and add you to the jumpbox group 3) test with: ```ssh maya@jump.redwood.internal -A``` If you hit MFA prompt let me know. Access form: https://access.redwood/requests (choose 'new-hire - infra')

Maya K.: I submitted the 'jumpbox-access' request about 10m ago. tried the ssh and got: "Permission denied (publickey)" — expected until group is added?

onboard-bot: Ticket #ONB-4321 created: jumpbox-access for u/maya by Maya K. Status: pending approval.

Lee (Infra): yup permission denied is expected until group add completes. Approvals usually take ~30-60m in business hours. I'm going to queue a reviewer now. For the prod DB read-only access we need manager + people-ops signoff; system requires a justification string in the request.

Samir: @Lee approved read-only for onboarding. @Rachel can you finalize in the access system?

Rachel - People Ops: approved — please update the DB request with 'onboarding: true' and add a one-line justification (what Maya wrote is fine). I'll expedite it. Also note SOC policy: include the ticket number in the request comments.

Maya K.: done — added justification and ticket #ONB-4321 to the DB request. Quick question: if I hit a stale token or something after hours who do I page?

Lee (Infra): after hours page infra-oncall (PagerDuty). For access issues that block onboarding we treat it as P2 during business hours; after hours the oncall SRE can triage. For policy exceptions email security@redwood.com and cc me.

Maya K.: awesome, thanks. one last thing — who maintains the service ownership map? want to find the right owner for a small microservice question later.

Samir: service ownership map lives in product docs. alias is product-platform (product-platform@redwood.com). I'll DM the direct link.

onboard-bot: ONB-4321 updated: jumpbox-access approved by Lee (Infra). Status: granted.

Maya K.: confirmed I can ssh now, and I can connect to the read-only DB. verified basic queries. thanks all :tada: 

Samir: nice — welcome aboard again! ping me if you want a quick walkthrough of infra queues.

Lee (Infra): added note for future new-hires: if you want to pre-provision jumpbox keys, include SSH pubkey in the access request to cut approval time.

Rachel - People Ops: tagging onboarding checklist to add that tip.

Maya K.: noted, will add my pubkey to my profile. thanks everyone :)
